v: You know Deerfoot Trail. But who was Deerfoot?
A Blackfoot runner. Chief Crowfoot's nephew.
In eighteen eighty-six, in Calgary, he beat an English runner over ten miles. By a full lap.
His rival's handlers claimed a miscount. So they raced again.
Deerfoot started six laps late. And still passed him.
In the nineteen seventies, a major Calgary road was named after him.
